subject: Re: DPA — cross-border transfer language & subprocessor audit
messages:
From: Amy Brown <amy.brown@acmehealth.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.example.com
Cc: legal@acmehealth.com
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: DPA redlines and subprocessor request

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the chat earlier. Attached are our procurement redlines for Redwood's standard DPA (Acme_DPA_Redlines_v1.pdf). Two items are blocking contracting on our side:

1) Customer-managed KMS or HSM for hosted workloads (Procurement requires BYOK for any PHI/PII processing in hosted tiers).
2) Right to conduct a limited on-site/remote subprocessor audit or a signed subprocessor attestation list updated quarterly.

We also need confirmation of cross-border transfer mechanisms (SCCs or equivalent), and a copy of your latest SOC 2 report. Our procurement deadline is Aug 31. Please advise next steps and whether you can accept these redlines or provide an alternative that meets our compliance team.

We would prefer to execute via DocuSign. HubSpot deal is HUB-9812 if that helps.

Thanks,
Amy Brown
Sr. Procurement Manager, Acme Health
amy.brown@acmehealth.com
Attachment: Acme_DPA_Redlines_v1.pdf

---
From: soojin_lee@redwood.example.com
To: Amy Brown <amy.brown@acmehealth.com>
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.example.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.example.com
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA redlines and subprocessor request

Hi Amy — thanks for sending and flagging the timeline. Looping in Naomi (Legal) and Rishi (Security) to review the redlines.

Immediate notes: we can provide SCCs for EU transfers and a current SOC 2 report (will share). The KMS / BYOK ask for Hosted API is not standard for our hosted tier; we do offer BYOK for Dedicated and Private deployments.

We will prepare a response to each redline and propose a path to keep you on the Aug 31 timeline (possible interim addendum + later transition to Private if required). Karthik (sales) will coordinate commercial levers if we need a one-time credit/discount for an accelerated Private deployment.

I will follow up after Legal/Security review (aiming EOD tomorrow).

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Exec — Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

---
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.example.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.example.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.example.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA redlines and subprocessor request

Soojin / team — I reviewed the redlines. High level:

- SCCs / international transfer: ACCEPTABLE. We can sign with SCCs (or equivalent) for transfers.
- SOC 2: we can provide the latest report under NDA.
- Subprocessor on-site audit: NOT ACCEPTABLE as written. We do provide a current subprocessor list and copies of providers' attestations (SOC2/ISO). We can agree to quarterly attestations and a remote evidence package, but not on-site audits of our vendors.
- BYOK/KMS for Hosted API: NOT AVAILABLE. Our hosted product does not support customer-managed keys for tenants. We can offer: 1) Dedicated or Private deployment with BYOK/HSM; or 2) contractual controls, encryption at rest, access controls, and logging for Hosted.

If Acme's procurement is immovable on BYOK for Hosted, we will need a formal exception approved by CRO/security leadership or a commitment to migrate to Private.

Next steps: Karthik, please surface any commercial accommodations (credits, timeline) that would make a Private deployment acceptable. Rishi, please prepare a one-page evidence pack showing encryption, logging, and subprocessors' attestations that we can send to Acme security.

Naomi Feldman
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
Attachment: (none)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com>
To: Amy Brown <amy.brown@acmehealth.com>, soojin_lee@redwood.example.com
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.example.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.example.com
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed compromise and next steps (Acme / Redwood DPA)

Hi Amy — appreciate the candor and the timeline. Two quick commercial suggestions to help unblock:

1) Interim addendum for execution: Redwood can offer an addendum that commits to SCCs + quarterly subprocessor attestations + a dedicated evidence package (SOC2 + encryption write-up). For Hosted customers, contractual commitments on data deletion and access controls will be included.

2) BYOK path: If Acme requires BYOK, we can commit to a Private deployment with BYOK within 45-60 days of contract signature. To help bridge the gap, Redwood is prepared to offer a one-time credit to offset migration costs (details to be approved by Sales Ops).

Attached is a draft response to your redlines (redline_response.docx). If Acme can accept the interim addendum and SOC2 package now, we can proceed to DocuSign immediately and provide a path to BYOK if required.

Please let me know whether you want us to push this to DocuSign today.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachment: redline_response.docx

---
From: Amy Brown <amy.brown@acmehealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com>, soojin_lee@redwood.example.com
Cc: legal@acmehealth.com
Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed compromise and next steps (Acme / Redwood DPA)

Karthik / Soojin — thanks for the quick proposals. Procurement reviewed the interim addendum and the SOC2 offer but our compliance and IT security teams remain firm: they will not accept hosted workloads without BYOK/HSM. The only acceptable path is Dedicated/Private with BYOK.

Procurement is willing to consider the migration credit, but we need explicit SLA language around data deletion and a written migration timeline in the contract. We also need the DocuSign-ready addendum and the exact onboarding schedule by EOD Monday (Aug 30) — otherwise we risk missing our internal procurement window and the supplier list cutoff.

Please escalate to your security leadership for a final decision and send the DocuSign link.

Regards,
Amy Brown
Sr. Procurement Manager, Acme Health
Attachment: (none)
Reference: HubSpot deal HUB-9812

From: soojin_lee@redwood.example.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.example.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example.com
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.example.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.example.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Escalation: Acme Health — KMS/BYOK requirement blocking DPA execution (need exec sign-off)

Marissa / Vivek — I need an exec-level decision. Context below (summary):

- Acme Health (HUB-9812) submitted DPA redlines that require BYOK/HSM for hosted workloads. Procurement deadline Aug 31.
- Legal (Naomi) confirms we cannot offer BYOK on Hosted. Options: 1) Commit to Private deployment with BYOK within 45-60 days; 2) Approve a security exception for Hosted that substitutes contractual controls, quarterly attestations, and a strong SLA around deletion.
- Sales (Karthik) proposes an interim addendum + migration credit to keep the deal on the table. Acme's procurement will only accept Private/BYOK path unless we get explicit security leadership sign-off.

Impact: if we cannot resolve by EOD Aug 30, Acme will pause procurement and move to alternative vendors. Estimated ARR at stake: $420k ARR (first-year).

Requested actions:
1) Vivek / security: authorize either (A) a formal exception to allow the Hosted contractual controls for this deal only (requires documented compensating controls and an evidence package), or (B) commit to the Private deployment timeline and provide a proposed statement of work and migration SLA we can share with Acme.
2) Marissa / leadership: approve a one-time migration credit (if option B) within the range proposed by Sales Ops to cover migration costs and shorten timeline.

Attachments: proposed_addendum_for_acme.pdf
Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/9812, https://docusign.com/s/ABC123-acme-dpa

Please advise urgent path so I can reply to Acme (they asked for DocuSign link and timeline by EOD).

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Account Exec — Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
